The soil here in the North Central is good for maize, but it has become tired after many years of cropping. I will apply some NPK fertilizer on this plot because without it the maize will not yield well, and I was able to get a small amount from the agro-dealer in town. I will use my own kept seed since the hybrid ones are too expensive for me, and my children will help with the planting, weeding, and harvest. We do not need to hire anyone for this small piece, and the rains here are reliable enough that I do not need to irrigate.
